# Ad creatives — Signing Agent HQ

Tre creative statiche per il **top-of-funnel** (fase di validazione). Angoli diversi,
da A/B testare. Tutte spingono al **lead magnet gratuito** (mileage log) → poi la
[sequenza email](../../../validation/notary-signing-agent-os/email-sequence.md) fa il resto.
Rigenerabili con [`../../../build/build_ads.py`](../../../build/build_ads.py).

| File | Formato | Canale | Angolo / hook |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ad-square-1080.png` | 1080×1080 | Facebook feed & **gruppi notai**, IG feed | Pain fiscale → "Stop losing money at tax time" |
| `ad-pin-1000x1500.png` | 1000×1500 (2:3) | **Pinterest**, IG feed | Il lead magnet stesso → "The Notary Mileage Log (free)" |
| `ad-story-1080x1920.png` | 1080×1920 (9:16) | IG/FB **Stories & Reels cover** | Hook POV → "it's tax season and your books are a mess" |

## Caption pronte

**Square (gruppi Facebook)** — *post organico, non promozionale*
> I built a free mileage log for notaries — it adds up your tax deduction automatically as you log each trip. If tax season ever stressed you out, comment **"MILE"** and I'll send it. (Mobile notaries & loan signing agents.)

**Pinterest pin**
> Free Notary Mileage Log — never miss a deductible mile again. Log every business trip in 10 seconds and watch your tax deduction add up. Perfect for mobile notaries & loan signing agents. #notary #loansigningagent #mobilenotary #notarylife #taxtips

**Story / Reel cover**
> POV: it's tax season and your notary books are a mess. Here's the fix → free mileage log in bio. #notary #signingagent #notarytok

## Note
- Le creative puntano al **lead magnet**, non alla vendita: in validazione l'obiettivo è far crescere la lista, non spingere il $19.
- Rispettano le **safe area** (story: contenuto entro ~250–1780px verticali).
- Hook allineati alle 3 varianti A/B in [`video-script-60s.md`](../../../validation/notary-signing-agent-os/video-script-60s.md).
- Nei gruppi Facebook: posta come **valore gratuito** (comment-to-get), non come ad — gli admin bannano la vendita diretta.
